name: Solana Patrol Bot
description: Rugged tracked robot for outdoor patrol, security, and surveillance operations

workflow.name: Initialize Outdoor Scene
workflow.prompt:
Set up an outdoor environment scene:

1. Clear all default objects
2. Set Metric units
3. Create collections: 'Robot', 'Terrain', 'Environment', 'Lights'

4. Create terrain:
   - Ground plane 10m x 10m
   - Add subdivision (4 levels)
   - Apply displacement for uneven terrain
   - Mix of grass/dirt/gravel textures

5. Lighting:
   - Use HDRI sky (outdoor/overcast)
   - Or create sun lamp at 30° elevation
   - Warm golden hour color temperature

6. Camera:
   - Position for dramatic low angle
   - Or wide establishing shot

7. Atmospheric:
   - Subtle distance fog
   - Volumetric light rays (optional)

workflow.name: Create Tracked Chassis
workflow.prompt:
Create the tracked robot chassis:

1. Main hull:
   - Elongated box: 0.40m x 0.35m x 0.10m
   - Angled front (15° slope)
   - Flat rear for access
   - Position at (0, 0, 0.10)

2. Track housings:
   - Two side pontoons
   - Each: 0.38m x 0.08m x 0.12m
   - Extend slightly beyond hull
   - Curved top profile

3. Track wells:
   - Open bottom for track contact
   - Internal structure visible

4. Top deck:
   - Flat sensor mounting area
   - Ventilation grilles
   - Access hatches

5. Armor details:
   - Bolt heads along seams
   - Reinforced corners
   - Lifting handles

6. Apply material:
   - 'mat_military_green' or 'mat_tactical_black'
   - Color RGB(0.15, 0.18, 0.12) for green
   - Weathered/scratched appearance

7. Name: 'patrol_chassis'
8. Add to 'Robot' collection

workflow.name: Create Track System
workflow.prompt:
Create tank-style track system (both sides):

1. Drive sprocket (rear):
   - Toothed wheel: 0.08m diameter
   - 12 teeth around circumference
   - Shaft hole center
   - Position at rear of track housing

2. Idler wheel (front):
   - Smooth wheel: 0.07m diameter
   - Tensioning mechanism
   - Position at front

3. Road wheels (5 per side):
   - Rubber-rimmed wheels: 0.06m diameter
   - Evenly spaced between sprockets
   - Suspension mounts visible

4. Track segments:
   - Create single track link:
     - Rubber pad: 0.04m x 0.08m x 0.015m
     - Metal connector pins
   - Array along track path
   - Wrap around all wheels
   - Or use simple band with texture

5. Track tensioner:
   - Spring mechanism at idler
   - Adjustment bolt

6. Apply materials:
   - Sprockets: mat_steel_painted
   - Road wheels: mat_rubber_wheel
   - Track: mat_rubber_track

7. Name: 'patrol_track_left', 'patrol_track_right'
8. Parent to chassis

workflow.name: Create Sensor Tower
workflow.prompt:
Create elevated sensor mast/tower:

1. Mast base:
   - Cylinder: 0.06m diameter, 0.15m height
   - Reinforced mounting to hull
   - Cable pass-through

2. Pan-tilt head:
   - Pan mechanism (horizontal rotation)
   - Tilt mechanism (vertical angle)
   - Smooth servo housings

3. Sensor payload platform:
   - Flat plate for mounting
   - 0.15m x 0.10m
   - Quick-release mounts

4. Protective housing:
   - Weather-resistant enclosure
   - Hinged or removable
   - Ventilation slots

5. Cable management:
   - Spiral wrap along mast
   - Strain relief at connections

6. Materials:
   - Mast: mat_aluminum_anodized_black
   - Housing: mat_plastic_tactical

7. Name: 'patrol_sensor_tower'
8. Parent to chassis

workflow.name: Create 3D LiDAR System
workflow.prompt:
Create high-performance 3D LiDAR:

1. LiDAR unit:
   - Velodyne/Ouster style
   - 100mm diameter, 150mm height
   - Mount on sensor tower
   - Position at top of mast

2. Features:
   - 64-channel appearance
   - Rotating head visible
   - Optical windows array
   - Cooling fins

3. Protective dome (optional):
   - Clear polycarbonate cover
   - Weather protection
   - De-icing heater (implied)

4. Mount:
   - Vibration-dampening base
   - Quick-disconnect
   - Leveling adjustment

5. Materials:
   - Unit: mat_lidar_black
   - Dome: mat_polycarbonate_clear

6. Name: 'patrol_lidar_3d'
7. Parent to sensor tower

workflow.name: Create Camera Array
workflow.prompt:
Create 360-degree camera system:

1. Front camera:
   - Main RGB + depth combo
   - 0° forward facing
   - High resolution

2. Side cameras (2x):
   - Wide-angle RGB
   - ±90° (left and right)
   - Weather sealed

3. Rear camera:
   - 180° rearward
   - For reversing/coverage

4. All cameras share:
   - Ruggedized housing
   - IR illuminator option
   - Lens wiper/heater
   - Anti-glare hood

5. Arrangement:
   - Mount around sensor tower base
   - Or integrate into hull
   - Overlapping fields of view

6. Thermal camera (optional):
   - FLIR-style unit
   - Separate mounting position

7. Materials:
   - Housing: mat_camera_housing_black
   - Lens: mat_glass_coated

8. Name: 'patrol_camera_front', etc.
9. Parent appropriately

workflow.name: Create Power System
workflow.prompt:
Create dual battery and power system:

1. Battery compartment:
   - Two large LiPo packs
   - 6S 10000mAh each
   - Position in hull center
   - Easy access hatch above

2. Battery packs:
   - 0.18m x 0.08m x 0.04m each
   - Side by side or stacked
   - Quick-disconnect connectors

3. Solar panel (optional):
   - Fold-out panel on top
   - 0.20m x 0.15m
   - Trickle charge capability

4. Power distribution:
   - Main fuse box
   - Voltage regulators
   - Power switch with key

5. Charging port:
   - External weatherproof port
   - Quick-charge compatible
   - Status indicator LEDs

6. Materials:
   - Batteries: mat_battery_black
   - Solar: mat_solar_cell (dark blue)

7. Name components appropriately
8. Parent to chassis

workflow.name: Create Communication Systems
workflow.prompt:
Create communication and antenna array:

1. Main antenna mast:
   - Telescoping or fixed
   - Height: 0.30m extended
   - Multi-band capability

2. WiFi/Mesh antennas:
   - 2x paddle antennas
   - Articulating mounts
   - 2.4GHz + 5GHz

3. 4G/LTE antenna:
   - Cellular modem antenna
   - Blade or whip style
   - Position for best signal

4. GPS antenna:
   - Puck style on top
   - Clear sky view
   - RTK-capable (optional)

5. Radio antenna (optional):
   - Long-range telemetry
   - 900MHz band

6. Antenna routing:
   - Protected cable runs
   - Lightning protection

7. Materials:
   - Antennas: mat_antenna_black
   - Mounts: mat_aluminum

8. Name and parent appropriately

workflow.name: Create Lighting System
workflow.prompt:
Create illumination and warning lights:

1. Headlights (front):
   - 2x high-intensity LEDs
   - Adjustable aim
   - High/low beam modes

2. Rear lights:
   - Red tail/brake lights
   - White reverse lights
   - Turn signals

3. Work lights:
   - 4x auxiliary spots
   - 360° coverage
   - Individually controllable

4. Warning beacon:
   - Rotating/flashing amber
   - Top of sensor tower
   - High visibility

5. IR illuminators:
   - For night vision cameras
   - 850nm or 940nm LEDs
   - Not visible to eye

6. Underglow (optional):
   - Ground illumination
   - Status indication
   - Solana colors

7. Apply emissive materials:
   - Headlights: mat_led_white (strength 10)
   - Beacon: mat_led_amber (strength 8)
   - IR: mat_led_ir (slight red, low emission)

8. Name: 'patrol_light_*'

workflow.name: Create Speaker/Siren System
workflow.prompt:
Create audio alert system:

1. Main speaker:
   - PA horn style
   - Forward facing
   - Weatherproof housing
   - 50W output

2. Siren unit:
   - Dual-tone siren
   - 120dB output
   - Protected grille

3. Positioning:
   - Front of hull
   - Visible deterrent
   - Clear projection path

4. Microphone (optional):
   - For two-way communication
   - Wind noise reduction
   - Array configuration

5. Materials:
   - Housing: mat_speaker_black
   - Grille: mat_perforated_steel

6. Name: 'patrol_speaker', 'patrol_siren'

workflow.name: Add Weatherproofing Details
workflow.prompt:
Add weather protection and ruggedness:

1. Seals and gaskets:
   - Rubber seals on all hatches
   - IP67 rating appearance

2. Drain holes:
   - At low points
   - Prevent water pooling

3. Protective covers:
   - Over connectors
   - Flip-up style
   - Tethered caps

4. Mudguards:
   - Over track openings
   - Reduce splash
   - Flexible rubber

5. Skid plates:
   - Underside protection
   - Smooth bottom
   - Replaceable wear strips

6. Lifting points:
   - Rated recovery hooks
   - Front and rear
   - Painted yellow

7. Apply weathered materials:
   - Add dirt/mud in track area
   - Slight rust hints on metal
   - Scratches on high-wear areas

workflow.name: Final Branding and Details
workflow.prompt:
Complete with branding and identification:

1. Solana branding:
   - Logo on both sides
   - Gradient purple-cyan
   - 0.08m diameter

2. Unit identification:
   - 'PATROL-001' designation
   - Reflective lettering
   - Front and rear

3. Warning labels:
   - 'AUTONOMOUS VEHICLE'
   - 'CAUTION: MOVING PARTS'
   - International symbols

4. QR code:
   - For identification
   - Links to status page

5. Reflective strips:
   - High-visibility tape
   - On all sides
   - Orange/white pattern

6. Final checks:
   - All parenting correct
   - Materials complete
   - No overlapping geometry
   - Origins set for animation

7. Save as 'solana_patrol_bot.blend'
